newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ringier unit sells 17.1 pct DSF stake to Taurus.
newsitem.headline: Ringier unit sells 17.1 pct DSF stake to Taurus.

text.p: Swiss publishing group Ringier AG said its Rincovision AG unit had sold its 17.1 percent stake in German sports broadcaster Deutsches Sportfernsehen (DSF) to majority owner Taurus GmbH. Terms were not disclosed.
It said in a statement the Kirch Gruppe was restructuring its TV operations in light of new German media laws and this included wrapping DSF into its digital DF1 company.
"To make a new orientation of the broadcaster possible with international partners from the sector, Rincovision has sold its 17.1 percent stake in DSF to majority shareholder Taurus GmbH," it said.
It said Ricovision would still work with DSF on programmes.
